snippet.title: The Funnel | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Try the demo and wishlist now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164380/The_Funnel/

Assemble gear boxes, get to know your crew, or escape the factory. The Funnel is a narrative puzzle game where your choices will not only lead to unique narrative paths but also unique minigames.

Learn more at: https://bronzemanstudio.com/funnel
